startup.checking.title: Checking protected storage
startup.checking.message: WinProfile is validating its protected workspace before any profile service starts.
startup.legacy.title: Older untrusted storage detected
startup.legacy.message: The recommended action moves the complete older WinProfile object aside without opening its contents, then creates a new protected workspace. No journal or snapshot is imported or restored.
startup.legacy.details:
Reason: {reason}

The moved data is untrusted and is not forensic evidence. Its previous permissions remain unchanged, so it may still be accessible to accounts that already had access. WinProfile will never delete it automatically.
startup.legacy.consent: I closed all other WinProfile instances and accept preserving the legacy permissions.
startup.resume.title: Storage recovery must be completed
startup.working.title: Securing the WinProfile workspace
startup.working.message: The exact legacy object is being detached and a new protected workspace is being verified.
startup.working.details: Do not close WinProfile. If Windows stops unexpectedly, the durable recovery journal will resume without moving the legacy object back.
startup.error.title: Protected storage is not ready
startup.error.message: WinProfile stopped before starting profile services. Review the technical details, close another WinProfile instance if needed, then retry or quit.
startup.close_blocked: Storage recovery is in progress. Wait for its durable checkpoint before closing WinProfile.
